exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Contrast and concession at advanced level

items.prompt: ___ pay transparency has clear advantages, its downsides are too easily dismissed.
___ the scheme was imperfect, the intent was sound.
items.hintAfterError: Depois vem uma oração completa; a expressão significa 'admitindo que'.

items.prompt: ___ strong shareholder opposition, the pay package was approved.
___ the committee approved the plan, several members had reservations.
items.hintAfterError: Antes de uma oração completa, 'Even' sozinho não funciona como conector.

items.prompt: ___ the talk of executive pay, most companies still design incentives poorly.
items.hintAfterError: Expressão formal de concessão com 2 palavras; a primeira é uma preposição curta.
